Across the later frames, the wearer turns or pans right: the nearby dark-clothed person shifts toward the left, another person’s black-clad legs enter within roughly 0.5 m, and a burgundy-clothed person becomes partly visible at the right edge. The wearer’s right arm extends forward-right and is within arm’s reach of the nearby people and, in the final frame, the tan dog about 0.5–1 m ahead-right; faces are mostly out of view, so gaze direction cannot be determined.
